model: YVAA / YVFA / YAGK Chiller (native BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: YORK YVAA, YVFA (free cooling) and YAGK air-cooled variable-speed screw chillers with the 031-03478 board and its native BAS port.
summary: YVAA, YVFA and YAGK chillers with the 031-03478 board have BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU and N2 built in, so no gateway is needed. The BAS writes the remote setpoint, current limit, sound limit and start/stop (AV 1-3, BV 1). Everything else is read-only AI and BI objects: chilled liquid and ambient temperatures, per-system pressures, temperatures, % FLA, hours, starts, kW, VSD values, condenser fan data, free cooling values, operational, fault and warning codes, and the chiller alarm.
notes: Access follows the sheet's sections: analog and binary write points (AV, BV) and read-only points (AI, BI).

The sheet marks every point Standard, Optional or Not available for seven firmware ranges. Points added in later firmware (free cooling closed loop, YAGK values, unit input current, kW, XL fan commands, flow switch, warning codes, anti-freeze and ready-to-start) are marked Not available on the early ranges and are kept; the spare objects (AV 4, BV 2-3) are left out.
Free cooling points apply to YVFA units, YAGK points (suction temperature, superheat, flash tank drain valve) to YAGK units. Values that don't apply are sent as zero.
Operational, fault and warning codes are numeric AIs; the states list the code values from the sheet's code tables.
BI 25 and BI 26 are condenser fan VSD fault flags; the sheet's description column for them repeats the XL fan speed text.
Units shown are imperial; SI units are in the sheet.

source.title: YVAA, YVFA, YAGK Native Modbus RTU, BACnet MS/TP, N2 Data Map

integration.summary: Put the chiller in remote control (BI 12 reads Remote), then start it with BV 1 and write the remote setpoint (AV 1) and current limit (AV 2); the setpoint and limit only take effect while the start command is active. Read BI 2 for chiller run, the leaving chilled liquid temperature, VSD frequency, BI 1 for the chiller alarm and the per-system fault codes for the cause.

minimum_points.name: LOCAL_REMOTE
minimum_points.why: Must read Remote (1) for BMS control

integration.enable: BI 12 shows Local or Remote control mode. The sheet gives no point to change it and no write-enable point. The remote setpoint (AV 1) and current limit (AV 2) only take effect while the start command is active.
integration.heartbeat: Operational code 67 is 'Loss of External Communications'; the sheet gives no timeout or heartbeat point.
setup: BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU and N2 are native on the 031-03478 board; a gateway is only needed for Connected Services.
The sheet gives no default MAC address, baud rate or device instance.
gotchas: Most data are AI/BI objects, not AV/BV; only AV 1-3 and BV 1 are writable.
The remote sound limit (AV 3) is ignored unless the remote sound limit option is enabled.
Fault codes are per system (AI 32-33); alarm on BI 1 and read both codes for the cause.
